content: षष्ठ {%a.%} (-ष्ठी|{%f.%}) Sixth, the sixth; षष्ठं तु क्षेत्रजस्यांशं प्रदद्यात् पैतृकाद्धनात् <ls>Ms. 9. 164</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 130</ls>; षष्ठे भागे <ls>V. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 17. 78</ls>; षष्ठे काले मयाऽऽहारः प्राप्तोऽयमनुजस्तव <ls>Mb. 3. 180. 16</ls>.

षष्ठी .²1 The sixth day of a lunar fortnight. .²2 The sixth or genitive case (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .²3 An epithet of Durgā in the form of Kātyāyanī, one of the 16 divine mothers. .²4 A goddess worshipped on the sixth day of child-birth (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>सटवाई</ns>); गणेशं जन्मदां षष्ठीं देवीं जीवन्तिकामपि <ls>Śiva B. 6. 48</ls>.
